description:
Resting at a fire sets a return checkpoint. Each fire can restore eligible companions’ HP and PP once every 15 real minutes; the cooldown survives saves and includes time away. It can restore zero-HP party members but leaves status conditions unchanged and excludes eggs and borrowed guides. It cannot retrieve an individual already lost in the astral realm.

A fire therefore offers a dependable pause without resolving every injury. A poisoned companion still needs attention after the warmth and full HP; returning to a familiar resting place has a practical purpose. Proposed staging: let the selected companion find room beside the child while distant route sounds remain audible. A quiet rest needs no new affection meter, prophecy or collectible.
